description: This file defines REST API endpoints for lobby management in a multiplayer game backend using FastAPI. It includes functionalities such as creating, retrieving, joining, leaving, inviting to, and starting matches from game lobbies. The endpoints interact with Redis for lobby state and Postgres for match persistence, and incorporate rate limiting and idempotency features.

methods.name: LobbyCreateResponse lobby_create( request: Request, body: LobbyCreateRequest, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], idempotency_key: Annotated[Optional[str], Depends(idempotency_key_header)], )
methods.description: Creates a new private lobby, backed by Redis, returning a join code.

methods.name: LobbyStateResponse lobby_get_state( request: Request, lobby_id: str, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], )
methods.description: Retrieves current state of a specified lobby from Redis.

methods.name: LobbyStateResponse lobby_join( request: Request, body: LobbyJoinRequest, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], idempotency_key: Annotated[Optional[str], Depends(idempotency_key_header)], )
methods.description: Allows a user to join a lobby via ID or code, with idempotency support.

methods.name: LobbyLeaveResponse lobby_leave( request: Request, lobby_id: str, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], idempotency_key: Annotated[Optional[str], Depends(idempotency_key_header)], )
methods.description: Enables a user to leave a lobby; if owner leaves, lobby is closed.

methods.name: LobbyInviteResponse lobby_invite( request: Request, body: LobbyInviteRequest, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], idempotency_key: Annotated[Optional[str], Depends(idempotency_key_header)], )
methods.description: Invites another user to join a lobby, restricted to the lobby owner.

methods.name: MatchStartResponse lobby_start_match( request: Request, body: LobbyStartMatchRequest, auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(db_session_dep)], )
methods.description: Starts a match from the lobby's current members, persisting data in PostgreSQL.
